feeds.title: Australian Security Magazine » Cyber Resilience
feeds.description: The Australian Security Magazine is the country's leading government and corporate security magazine. It is a highly respected and sought-after publication, incorporating investigative journalism, and provoking editorial and up-to-date news, trends, and events for all security professionals.

feeds.title: Australian Cyber Security Magazine
feeds.description: The Australian Cyber Security Magazine offers information on threats, trends, and solutions in cybersecurity. Offering professional analysis and guidance for both consumers and corporations, it covers issues like as malware, data breaches, and upcoming technology. It is an invaluable tool for keeping up with cybersecurity advancements in Australia and throughout the world, with articles, interviews, and industry updates.

feeds.title: Exploit Security Blog
feeds.description: Exploit Security offers security consultancy through a connected group of white-hat freelancers. Lean inside their blog and take a deep dive into the world of cyber security and penetration testing. Master the inner-workings of security software and learn how to strengthen your systems.

feeds.title: Improve your cyber security effectiveness | Cyooda Security
feeds.description: Cyooda Security is an independent information security consulting and advisory practice. It was founded in 2023 by John Reeman, a former Chief Information Security Officer and cybersecurity advisor with over twenty-five years of extensive security and industry experience gained by working with some of the largest global organizations and government agencies. In a world where threats evolve at lightning speed, our approach to cyber security is anchored in our name, CY - for Cyber and OODA for -Observe, Orient, Decide, Act.

feeds.title: Triskele Labs Blog
feeds.description: Triskele Labs was founded in 2014 by a team of Cyber Security experts passionate about delivering outstanding experiences. We are Cyber Security experts, that's a given. But we also understand that customer experience, communication, and service delivery are equally important.

feeds.title: Security Brief Australia
feeds.description: SecurityBrief Australia is focused on cybersecurity and cyberattack news. Its readers include business and enterprise security decision-makers. Security Brief Australia is a purely digital publisher that aspires to be the leading source of technology news globally. We run an extensive network of technology news websites throughout the globe, with sites in Asia, Australia and New Zealand.

feeds.title: NAB News » Cyber Security
feeds.description: We're here to serve customers well and help our communities prosper. We became NAB when the National Bank of Australasia (est. 1858) merged with the Commercial Banking Company of Sydney (est. 1834) on October 1, 1981. Our scale and connectivity help us to tackle some of the biggest challenges facing our business and community. We're focusing on taking climate action, supporting affordable and specialist housing and backing Indigenous businesses.

feeds.title: Cybra Security Blog
feeds.description: Cybra is a collection of veteran Australian cyber security professionals who are not afraid to challenge the status quo. We provide realistic and practical advice on how to arm yourself against threats, both internal and external to your business. Our mission is to make cyber security accessible for all Australian businesses.

feeds.title: Oceania Cyber Security Centre News
feeds.description: The OCSC was established in 2016 between eight Victorian Universities and the State Government of Victoria. The Oceania Cyber Security Centre's (OCSC) vision is to advance cybersecurity education and research. Its mission is to work at the forefront of research to strengthen cyber security capacity and maturity and to build contextualized digital resilience in Australia and in the wider Indo-Pacific region.

feeds.title: Security Centric Blog
feeds.description: Security Centric offers information and cyber security consulting services alongside professional engineering services. Founded in 2012, our mission is to genuinely help organizations better understand risk in the context of information security, and work with you to ensure appropriate measures are in place to effectively manage these risks on an ongoing basis.

feeds.title: Ionize
feeds.description: Australia's leading full-spectrum cyber security services provider. Ionize was established in 2008 based on the belief that everyone deserves better cybersecurity. Go digital with confidence.Stop second-guessing whether your security posture, people, and business systems are aligned, with Ionize HAWC.

feeds.title: Gridware Blog
feeds.description: Founded in Sydney, Australia, Gridware has grown to become a leader in cybersecurity and incident response services both locally and internationally. The Gridware helps out-innovate hackers by driving and delivering real innovation in the cyber security industry. Our mission is to help people, governments and businesses around the world defend themselves against cybercrime and reduce their risk exposure in an always-connected world.

feeds.title: Huntsman Blog
feeds.description: Established in 1999, we aim to provide security technology to measure, report and reduce cyber risk to enable the digital transformation of governments and businesses to more efficient operating models, while at the same time complying with the increasing demands of legislative requirements.

feeds.title: Cosiv Blog
feeds.description: We are industry veterans who bring over 17 years of security experience to every engagement. Cosive works with leading organizations Australasia-wide to improve their security posture. We are experts in the use of threat intelligence and security orchestration. We also offer malware analysis solutions, endpoint protection, and intelligence enrichment systems.

feeds.title: Infotrust
feeds.description: We protect Australia's leading brands and businesses against cyber threats. We pride ourselves on being uniquely different, we not only deliver world-class cyber security managed services, but we also have a wealth of experience in understanding data, the lifeblood of any organization.
